past_reference.material_point_formula: inv(G0) @ A_prev @ inv(A0) @ G0 @ p0 - p0
past_reference.source_frame: fixed current LiDAR R, full 3D metres
past_reference.predicted_history: signed_dt_seconds * fixed four nominal horizon LSQ D velocity; no GT in velocity

forward_2s_geometry_gate.scope: every original valid 2s source point, including covered/history-missing points
forward_2s_geometry_gate.formula: same original rigid geometry helper and original authenticated full grid
forward_2s_geometry_gate.usage: geometry validation only, never a historical score feature

populations.main: original future-valid AND CRN owner<0 AND original camera reason==0 AND history reason==0
populations.history_missing: retained in original full-future denominator bookkeeping; not zero-imputed
populations.camera_selection: reuse already frozen input-only camera selection and mask; labels cannot alter it
populations.GT_group_usage: descriptive scoring-only partition; every group retained; all-speed group tables, seven-bin table only no_radar/all

full_denominator: ALL original valid future objects at that horizon, including covered, no-history and camera-missing
bins: left closed right open, all seven plus all-speeds

auc_tasks.common_support: same population for all seven entries in each cell
auc_tasks.zero_benefit: exclude only from that binary AUC; count zero and retain physical bookkeeping
auc_tasks.undefined: null if either weighted class absent

sign_table.entries: original point weights and full-future denominator future gain/cost; zero rows/columns explicit

coverage: All original future points and separately CRN-uncovered radar strata retain all three history reasons and all four future GT groups. All-speed tables also cross history status with five camera reasons. Seven speed bins only no-radar/all. Covered points remain in original future accounting.
frozen_authentication_reuse: analyze_history_camera_evidence_train_v1.dependencies/authenticate/collect, which bind original motion/radar/camera sources and weights
interpretation: This is train512 already seen by D; validation was historically exposed and is not read here.
GT boxes are virtual rigid material-point labels, not measured surfaces or scene flow.
Previous/current sample-keyframe box times differ from each camera timestamp, typically tens of milliseconds; report actual offsets. No perfect-photometry or camera-time-oracle claim.
Bpast is a privileged diagnostic reference, not a mathematical upper bound and not an inference signal.
Near-zero benefits can affect sign AUC; ranking does not certify practical routing or future occupancy/motion gains.
Input-only photometry definition and source/camera support remain unchanged.

Bpast and future benefit share D magnitude; if H=0 then Bpast=-norm(Dpast). High pooled oracle-reference AUC alone cannot establish temporal discriminability; inspect same-population D-speed controls and future GT groups/fixed speed bins.
One historical score is shared by all four future horizons; these are not four independent pieces of historical evidence.
